name: Sword Of Shoguns
review:
Samurai on six reels with 5,040 ways, expanding symbols, wilds and free spins.

Expanding symbols across 5,040 ways can produce big hits when a premium symbol fills several reels at once, and that's what the free spins are all about. Very high volatility and a 25,200x cap mean it's built for patient players who can ride out quiet spells. 96.15% RTP, which is a fair figure for Thunderkick.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
